scene.label: Act 1, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. A room in Leonato's house.

lines.text: How now, brother? Where is my cousin your son? Hath he provided this music?
lines.plainText: How now brother Where is my cousin your son Hath he provided this music

lines.text: He is very busy about it. But, brother, I can tell you strange news that you yet dreamt not of.
lines.plainText: He is very busy about it But brother I can tell you strange news that you yet dreamt not of

lines.text: As the event stamps them: but they have a good cover; they show well outward. The Prince and Count Claudio, walking in a thick-pleached alley in my orchard, were thus much overheard by a man of mine: the Prince discovered to Claudio that he loved my niece your daughter and meant to acknowledge it this night in a dance; and if he found her accordant, he meant to take the present time by the top and instantly break with you of it.
lines.plainText: As the event stamps them but they have a good cover they show well outward The Prince and Count Claudio walking in a thickpleached alley in my orchard were thus much overheard by a man of mine the Prince discovered to Claudio that he loved my niece your daughter and meant to acknowledge it this night in a dance and if he found her accordant he meant to take the present time by the top and instantly break with you of it

lines.text: Hath the fellow any wit that told you this?
lines.plainText: Hath the fellow any wit that told you this

lines.text: A good sharp fellow: I will send for him; and question him yourself.
lines.plainText: A good sharp fellow I will send for him and question him yourself

lines.text: No, no; we will hold it as a dream till it appear itself: but I will acquaint my daughter withal, that she may be the better prepared for an answer, if peradventure this be true. Go you and tell her of it.
